'''Visfuu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who ran a shop selling [[data book]]s in [[Isttu Village]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']]. She enjoyed talking with her customers.
